rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for moving nimbly around or back and forth, especially for insects or birds.

example.english: I watched a butterfly flit around the garden.
example.traditional: 我見到隻蝴蝶喺花園入面飛嚟飛去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 zek3 wu4 dip6 hai2 faa1 jyun2 jap6 min6 fei1 lai4 fei1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on quickly going to a different place rather than darting around in several directions.

example.english: After work, we flit over to the supermarket to pick up some things.
example.traditional: 放工之後，我哋飛去超級市場買嘢。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 fei1 heoi3 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 maai5 je5
